description: This file defines the DockIconManager class responsible for managing the visibility of the app's Dock icon based on window visibility and user preferences. It observes window changes and user defaults to dynamically update the Dock icon's display state.
external_files: Foundation (implicitly via NS* classes and NotificationCenter)

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the visibility of the application's Dock icon based on window states and user preferences.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Determines whether to show or hide the Dock icon based on current window visibility and user settings.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily sets the Dock icon to be visible by changing its activation policy.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Initializes observers for window changes and user defaults to trigger Dock icon updates accordingly.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handler invoked when window visibility changes, prompting an update of the Dock icon visibility.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handler invoked when user preferences related to the Dock icon change, prompting an update.
